verdict.rationale: llamafile ships whisperfile, its own single-file on-device speech-to-text tool built on whisper.cpp, and the docs stress fully local, offline execution. The evidence only covers transcription and translation of audio files, not live dictation or real-time streaming from a microphone. Missing for 10: real-time/streaming transcription, live microphone dictation input, latency evidence, hands-on corroboration of whisperfile.
